evidenceAndExamples.statement: A permission interpreter is tested on reversed order and interleaved keys, while the proof remains conditional on the input log.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Consolidation is not proof, transactions cannot undo arbitrary external effects and sandboxing does not establish correctness.

audit.notes: Source-grounded analysis; proposed mechanisms and limited guarantees preserved.
